name: What power source options are available for outdoor kitchen lighting?

mainEntity.name: What power source options are available for outdoor kitchen lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outdoor kitchen lighting typically uses low-voltage or line-voltage systems. Low-voltage systems (12V) are safer, easier to install, and ideal for accent lighting, requiring a transformer to reduce household current. Line-voltage systems (120V) offer brighter light and are suitable for task lighting but require professional installation due to electrical safety standards. Solar-powered lights are an option for smaller, less critical areas but may not provide consistent brightness. A primary decision factor is the required brightness and whether new wiring runs will be integrated with existing home electrical systems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Outdoor kitchen lighting uses low-voltage (safer, easier) or line-voltage (brighter, professional install needed) systems. Solar is an option for accents.
